info.name: AI in Talk
info.summary: An AI bot for Talk that reads the files you share, searches the web and sends files back
info.description:
A bot for Nextcloud Talk that answers through [AI-Hub](https://apps.nextcloud.com/apps/ai_hub), the AI connection of your server.
- **Reads what you share** in the conversation: images, text, Markdown, CSV, Word, ODT, Excel, PowerPoint and PDF files - **Finds your files** by name, when you ask about one - **Sends files back**: Markdown, text, CSV, HTML, ODT, or PDF (with Collabora) - **Searches the web**, when the AI connection can - Everything runs **with the asking person's rights**: the bot sees only what they may see
Enable the bot in a conversation (conversation settings, Bots). In a conversation with one person it answers every message; with more people, when it is named (@AI) or replied to.
info.author: Dawid Ciepiela
